title: Separate loopback operator API, not room-host API
$comment: GET /api/operator/status and /api/operator/jobs/{job_id}; POST /api/operator/jobs CreateJob; POST /api/operator/jobs/{job_id}/{confirm|apply|cancel|recover} empty object. Exact separate bearer identity; raw opaque credential bytes are base64url-transported without normalization. Exact Host and Origin; no CORS and no path/URL/shell fields. Unix peer uses the same bounded fixed v1 protocol with socket0660 and separate UID. HTTP202 is an acknowledgement; durable job state determines outcome after reload/502. No initial-install API, arbitrary uploads or consumer credential fallback.
